title: Optimistic Locking with Version Columns
realWorldScenario: An enterprise CRM system has users editing customer profile pages in browser tabs for minutes at a time. Holding a database lock for minutes with SELECT FOR UPDATE would exhaust connections and freeze the database.
questionStatement: What is Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC)? How does a version number or updated_at column implement optimistic locking in application SQL?
expectedConcepts: Zero database lock holding during user think time
Version column comparison in WHERE clause
hints: Check the version in the WHERE clause and increment it in SET.
